baseline_models.mechanism: The dual is brought into being by measure and proportion, while haqq supplies reality-conformity and tight coherence; purpose is built into the pair rather than appended to it.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the design operation by which the dual is made.
Firm correspondence to reality makes the design non-false and non-empty.
Tight-made firmness turns separate proportions into a coherent order.

changed_reading.before: The pair was simply created truthfully.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a measured, internally firm order whose proportions instantiate reality.

baseline_models.mechanism: Creation occurs with an embedded due: bringing the pair into being also establishes obligations and entitlements within it, so haqq is juridical as well as descriptive.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the domain in which claims can become operative.
A due obligation makes haqq something creation binds its occupants to honor.
An owned entitlement gives the created order a distribution of protected claims.

changed_reading.before: Haqq names only the truthfulness of creation.
changed_reading.after: Haqq also names dues and claims that creation itself makes real and binding.

baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical increase and rivalry stand against disclosure: a crowd can amplify confidence, speech, and social dominance without increasing recognition.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance supplies the many whose count is explicitly contrasted with knowing.
Outnumbering and rivalry make majority a source of social leverage rather than evidence.
Knowing as disclosure supplies the epistemic measure that mere number fails to meet.

changed_reading.before: Most people happen to lack a fact.
changed_reading.after: Majority status is epistemically inverted: numerical dominance can coexist with failure to recognize what is disclosed.

baseline_models.mechanism: The pair's complete formed features can themselves function as distinguishing marks; the final negated knowing then describes failure to read a made sign, not absence of evidence.

activation_trace.role: Complete visible formation supplies the inspectable evidence carried by the created pair.
A distinguishing mark turns formed features into guides toward what made them meaningful.
Making truth stand is the evidentiary result the marks are capable of producing.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing is a deficit located only in the observers.
changed_reading.after: The created pair is a marked disclosure, while not knowing is a failure of uptake before available evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inscription that establishes a determination, disclosure, differentiation, and firm workmanship convert measured creation from mute geometry into an articulated and executable order.

activation_trace.role: Measured proportion remains the focus-side operation that the context renders articulate.
Tight-made firmness supplies the focus-side integrity of the articulated order.
Inscription that makes a determination binding supplies an ordered specification.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes that specification legible.
Differentiation supplies distinct allocations within the single created order.
Firm, exact workmanship supplies executability rather than mere verbal description.

structural_cues: 44:2-4 moves from a manifest book to the differentiation of every firmly ordered affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, disclosure, differentiation, and firm workmanship; I infer that measured creation enacts an articulated order. A live alternative is that these branches characterize revelation alone.

changed_reading.before: Creation is a proportioned but largely mute order.
changed_reading.after: Creation is the enacted, differentiated counterpart of a legible and binding specification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy, nurturing completion, enlivening, and causing death recast creation as sustained governance through transitions rather than a finished event at the beginning.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the focus-side beginning that the context extends into governance.
Making truth stand supplies a goal progressively realized through governance.
Tender mercy gives the governing process a beneficent mode rather than bare control.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply ongoing formation after origination.
Earth revived by rain and growth supplies a visible cycle of renewed formation.
Loss of life and force makes death a governed transition within the same order.

structural_cues: 44:6 names mercy, 44:7 expands lordship across the heavens, earth, and between, and 44:8 coordinates giving life with causing death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, completion, revival, and death; I infer that haqq is maintained through ongoing governance. A live alternative keeps creation and later governance as separate predicates.

changed_reading.before: The pair was truthfully originated once.
changed_reading.after: The pair is continuously brought toward truthful completion through merciful cycles of life and death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interpenetrating doubt and purposeless play become an obscuring atmosphere; covering, requested uncovering, and return make not-knowing a recurrently rebuilt condition rather than a stable lack of data.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the focus-side possibility repeatedly blocked by occlusion.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without settled certainty supply cognitive instability.
Action without a sound aim turns instability into a sustained practical posture.
Smoke-like black turbidity materializes the loss of epistemic clarity.
A cover lying over and concealing a thing supplies the mechanism of blocked disclosure.
Lifting a cover supplies a temporary reversal of the blockage.
Return after departure closes the loop by restoring the prior posture.

structural_cues: 44:9-15 sequences doubt and play, covering affliction, a plea for uncovering, brief removal, and announced return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the cover-uncover-return sequence; I infer that conduct helps reconstitute ignorance after relief. A live alternative treats play and return as symptoms of an unchanged disbelief rather than causes of re-occlusion.

changed_reading.before: Most do not know because disclosure has not reached them.
changed_reading.after: Most repeatedly convert available disclosure into renewed not-knowing through doubt, play, and return after uncovering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Performance of a due, compelling authority, and transfer of possession make history an arena where the claims embedded in creation can be demanded, resisted, and reassigned.

activation_trace.role: Due obligation anchors the historical demands in the focus's haqq.
A particular owned right makes possession answerable to entitlement.
Delivering a right or trust supplies the demanded act of restitution.
Compelling proof supplies authority for the claim rather than naked seizure.
Transfer without contract or effort supplies the reversal of apparently settled possession.

structural_cues: 44:18 demands delivery of servants, while 44:25-28 moves abandoned estates and pleasures to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies due performance, compelling authority, and uncontracted transfer; I infer that created haqq includes revocable possession and restorative reassignment. A live alternative confines the mechanism to one political rescue.

changed_reading.before: Haqq is an abstract property of the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Haqq operates historically as claims that can dispossess an oppressor and restore persons and goods to another ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge, visible signs, and a test that reveals condition turn evidence into a diagnostic encounter; denial of renewed life and demands for verification expose the reader of the signs rather than showing that signs were absent.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors knowing in the reading of available signs.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the explicit basis and field of selection.
A visible sign supplies evidence presented for interpretation.
A test that makes condition appear turns response to evidence into diagnosis.
Reviving the dead supplies the proposition denied despite the sign field.
Making word and deed come true supplies the challengers' demanded standard of proof.

structural_cues: 44:32-36 sequences selection on knowledge, given signs containing a manifest trial, denial of resurrection, and a challenge to produce the ancestors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, a revealing test, denial, and a proof-demand; I infer that signs diagnose the interpreter's relation to evidence. A live alternative takes the trial as hardship or favor without an epistemic testing function.

changed_reading.before: Created marks simply transmit information to passive observers.
changed_reading.after: Created marks test and disclose observers: not-knowing is a failed relation to evidence, not merely missing content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent identification of the created dual, denial of play, and then an appointed separating gathering give haqq a temporal arrow: purposeful structure culminates in adjudication where borrowed support cannot transfer outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Measured proportion anchors the endpoint in the focus's created design.
Making truth stand supplies the result toward which the design moves.
Repeated creation identifies the dual as the heavens and earth and preserves the measured-design image.
Aimless action is explicitly excluded, forcing a purposive reading of the dual.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the purpose's adjudicative endpoint.
An appointed time gives the endpoint a fixed temporal boundary.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the comprehensive assembly for separation.
Withholding aid removes social support as a way to defeat the separating outcome.

structural_cues: 44:38 supplies the dual antecedent and negates play; 44:40-41 immediately names the fixed Day of Separation and disables patronal aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, purposive negation, fixed time, separation, gathering, and failed aid; I infer that present design points toward adjudication. A live alternative is that the Day confirms purpose without exhausting the range of haqq.

changed_reading.before: The created pair has purpose, but its endpoint is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The measured heavens-earth order is calibrated toward an appointed gathering that separates claims and makes truth stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Food, interior boiling, pouring, tasting as experience, and recalled dispute convert denied truth from an external proposition into unavoidable bodily knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Making truth stand anchors the verification that the material sequence enforces.
Knowing through disclosure supplies the focus-side state that experience eventually compels.
Taking in and tasting food begins the passage from external object to bodily encounter.
The body's interior supplies the site where the denied order becomes inescapably present.
Pouring supplies the forced directional transfer into experience.
Tasting as direct experience supplies verification no longer held at argumentative distance.
Denial and disputation identify the prior resistance that bodily verification reverses.

structural_cues: 44:44-50 moves from food to boiling within, forced pouring, the imperative to taste, and identification of the experience as what had been disputed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ingestion, interiority, tasting, and prior dispute; I infer an epistemic reversal from denial to forced experience. A live alternative reads tasting only as an idiom of punishment without a knowledge mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Haqq can remain an external proposition that most decline to know.
changed_reading.after: The order called haqq can become embodied verification: what was disputed outside is finally known from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact fit, merciful exception, secure station, pairing, protection, and surplus recast haqq as placement into congruent relations and habitats, while surplus prevents that fit from collapsing into strict earned equivalence.

activation_trace.role: A fitted socket or exact middle supplies the focus-side image of congruent placement.
Tender mercy supplies an exception that cannot be reduced to mechanical desert.
A station and settled residence supply the fitted habitat.
Security and settled trust specify the habitat's affective condition.
Making one thing a counterpart to another supplies relational congruence.
Protective deflection supplies the boundary preserving the secure placement.
Surplus and remainder keep the fitted outcome open to gift beyond equivalence.

structural_cues: 44:41-57 moves from failed patronal aid through mercy into secure residence, pairing, protection, and an explicitly surplus gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secure station, pairing, protection, and surplus; I infer that created haqq can terminate in fitting relations. A live alternative is that grace interrupts rather than completes any logic of exact fit.

changed_reading.before: Truthful creation culminates only in separating judgment.
changed_reading.after: Alongside separation, haqq can appear as mercifully fitted placement into secure relations, with gift exceeding strict due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease after difficulty, language as message-bearing speech, reminder, and doubled watching extend the marked-creation model into communication and delayed verification; not-knowing is no longer explained by inaccessibility alone.

activation_trace.role: A mark that guides anchors the focus-side legibility expanded by speech.
Opening and ease after difficulty remove an access barrier to the message.
Language and speech supply a humanly receivable channel for the order's signs.
A reminder supplies renewed uptake rather than first-time information alone.
Mutual waiting supplies a temporal test in which rival readings remain exposed to outcome.

structural_cues: 44:58 makes the message easy in the addressee's tongue for remembrance, and 44:59 closes with reciprocal watching.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, language, reminder, and reciprocal waiting; I infer that legibility shifts responsibility from access toward response and eventual verification. A live alternative confines ease to rhetoric without linking speech to created signs.

changed_reading.before: The created pair bears marks, but their communicative reach is uncertain.
changed_reading.after: Created marks and accessible speech form parallel disclosures; most fail to know despite reiterated, humanly legible access, while time tests the readings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends focus ك ث ر from numerical majority to roiling dust and activates a non-dominant م ر ي mapping as wind-raised dust. It remains anchored in أَكْثَرَهُمْ and the context's smoke and dispute, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for crowd-generated obscurity, never as a lexical replacement for 'most'.

activation_trace.role: Abundant dust rising and roiling turns numerical accumulation into an obscuring material analogy.
Disclosure supplies what the crowd-like cloud makes difficult to see.
Smoke-like black turbidity supplies the context's explicit obscuring medium.
The non-dominant image of wind-raised dust links repeated disputation to renewed atmospheric obscurity.

changed_reading.before: The majority is a static count of people who do not know.
changed_reading.after: Accumulated and repeated contestation can behave like a dust cloud: the majority helps produce the obscurity in which it fails to know.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant haqq image of a straight penetrating thrust. It remains anchored in بِالْحَقِّ and gains a visible spatial mechanism from pouring, belly, and tasting, but downstream prose should qualify it as a directional material analogy, not claim that haqq lexically means a thrust here.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust that reaches the interior supplies the outlier's directional image of truth crossing resistance.
The interior of the body supplies the destination of the penetrating analogy.
Pouring supplies the forced movement from above and outside toward the body.
Direct experience supplies the epistemic effect once the movement reaches its destination.

changed_reading.before: Truth remains an external statement that can be held at argumentative distance.
changed_reading.after: Truth has a context-activated directional force: resisted disclosure eventually crosses into interior experience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the specialized haqq image of an animal reaching due bearing age to the non-dominant ر ب و growth inventory carried under contextual ر ب ب. It remains anchored in بِالْحَقِّ and the explicit appointed time, but prose should render it as a maturation analogy and disclose that the growth cue comes from a split, non-dominant mapping.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the due age for bearing or use supplies the focus-side image of ripened fitness.
The split root's non-dominant nourishment and growth image supplies maturation toward that fitness.
An appointed time supplies the moment at which maturation becomes due and operative.

changed_reading.before: Haqq is fully static at the instant of origin.
changed_reading.after: The created order can be imagined as timed to mature into a due condition whose fitness appears at its appointed phase.

strongest_changes: Measured creation became the enacted counterpart of an articulated, differentiated order.
Not-knowing became recurrent occlusion and failed diagnostic uptake rather than mere lack of information.
Haqq acquired a temporal arrow toward appointed separation and an experiential arrow toward embodied verification.
Juridical restitution and mercifully fitted surplus remained live together instead of being merged into one theory.
summary.what_was_special: The immediate context both resolves the dual as heavens and earth and places purposeful creation between earlier cycles of obscuring refusal and later separation, bodily verification, secure placement, and accessible reminder. Branches for due claim, exact fit, marks, dust, and maturation kept several causal models alive at once.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone leaves the dual pronoun unresolved; its heavens-earth antecedent is a context-activated reading.
Truth, due obligation, purpose, and fittedness may overlap in بِالْحَقِّ without any one exhausting the construction.
Doubt and play may cause renewed not-knowing, or may only expose a prior refusal.
The dust, penetration, and maturation outliers are controlled analogies, not lexical substitutions.
